advisorySource.note: The npm registry advisory endpoint answers from the lockfile's resolved name@version set. No node_modules, credential or environment value is read.

note: Blocking severities are declared here, not in code, so a policy change is a reviewable one-line diff. `enforcement: block` (Issue #645) fails the build on any blocking finding that no approved exception covers, and still fails closed on unavailable advisory data; the escalation path and the exception procedure are described in docs/runbook/dependency-advisories.md section 6.

exceptions.reason: No patched release is published (npm reports patched_versions_unpublished), so there is nothing to upgrade to; the only dependency paths are .>@pandacss/dev>@pandacss/node>fast-glob>micromatch>braces and .>@pandacss/dev>@pandacss/postcss>@pandacss/node>fast-glob>micromatch>braces, both dev-only build tooling (@pandacss/dev is a devDependency used by the Panda CSS codegen), and braces/micromatch/fast-glob are absent from the Worker runtime bundle, so the stack-exhaustion denial of service has no production path. Retire this record when a patched braces is published, when the dependency path changes, or when the dependency is dropped.
